description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Anspol Kecasso)
- Vendor B (Momirans Talsan)
- Vendor C (Ozvokke Lutirans)
- Vendor D (Dravok Lutho)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Anspol Kecasso):
  - Vendor A has no published product roadmap
  - Vendor A does not meet accessibility standards
  - Vendor A imposes heavy penalties for contract exit
  - Vendor A offers 24/7 on-call support
Vendor B (Momirans Talsan):
  - Vendor B has high engineering staff turnover
  - Vendor B had a pilot cancelled at a peer hospital
  - Vendor B has no published product roadmap
  - Vendor B quoted a total cost of 384 thousand per year
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 3 months
Vendor C (Ozvokke Lutirans):
  - Vendor C is financially stable
  - Vendor C provides on-site staff training
  - Vendor C had a pilot cancelled at a peer hospital
Vendor D (Dravok Lutho):

  - Vendor D allows no customisation
  - Vendor D supports standard interoperability formats
  - Vendor D completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
